text:
sara: Heads-up: prod incident this morning where tenants oscillated between dedicated A100s and preemptible T4s. Autoscaler spun up preemptible too eagerly and allocator packed across types, causing evictions. saw ~3x churn in 10m.
ben: Ugh. saw metrics. evictions spike aligned with preemptible-join events. autoscaler treats all capacity as equal in decision window.
julia: Two quick ideas: (1) treat preemptible as graded (warm/cold) not binary; (2) expose a confidence score from allocator about placement stability.
sara: Explain graded?
julia: Warm preemptible = same SKU/zone as dedicated and likely to stay (weight high). Cold preemptible = different SKU or spotty, weight low. Ramp rules: warm->100% in 30s, cold->30% in 5m.
raj: I like confidence score. allocator can return placement_hint: {score:0-100, frag_pct:0.0-1.0}. admission uses score*weight to compute effective headroom. keeps admission simple but more informed.
ben: Example config sketch: 
```yaml
preemptible_tiers:
  warm:
    match_sku: true
    ramp: 30s
    start_weight: 0.6
  cold:
    match_sku: false
    ramp: 5m
    start_weight: 0.2
placement_hint_schema: "score,fragmentation"
per_tenant_qos_key: "prefer_no_preemptible"
```
raj: Also recommend an "elasticity_penalty" when mixing SKUs: if pack mixes A100+T4 for same tenant, add penalty so autoscaler prefers homogeneous fill. prevents eviction when preemptible removed.
sara: Another operational idea: when a tenant gets evicted from preemptible, add a tenant-level backoff flag (eviction_backoff_ms) so subsequent admissions avoid preemptible for a short TTL. reduces immediate reassign.
julia: Telemetry we need: preemptible_join_latency, eviction_after_preemptible_ms, placement_score_histogram, mix_penalty_invocations. correlate with tenant SLO breaches.
ben: UX: tenant opt-in/out for preemptible via control-plane toggles. default: off for latency SLO customers. Cost-conscious tenants can opt-in and accept lower placement_score thresholds.
sara: rollout plan: feature flag gated, enable in staging -> smoke with a canary tenant group -> widen. high-risk metric: eviction_rate > 0.5%/min.
deploy-bot: Canary feature flag "preemptible-grading" enabled for staging at 2026-03-23T09:12Z.
ops-bot: Created tracker issue <https://go/redwood/dedicated-preemptible-grading> and alerted on-call channel.
raj: Action items: 1) allocator to emit placement_hint (will open PR), 2) autoscaler/admission to apply tiered ramping + mix penalty (I'll prototype), 3) control-plane to add per-tenant QoS toggle + eviction backoff (ben), 4) ops to add telemetry dashboards (julia).
julia: I'll draft the RFC with diagrams and rollout steps. aim to link perf sims and retrospective from this morning.
sara: Thanks all. please ping here when PRs land. keep the config conservative initially. :+1:
